# Psalm 115 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 115:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-our-God in-the-heavens; all which he-pleased he-has-done.
- **LOGOS:** Our God is in the heavens; he does all that he pleases.
- **PNEUMA:** Our God is in heaven — he does whatever he wants!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 115:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Their-hands and-not they-feel; their-feet and-not they-walk; not they-make-a-sound in-their-throat.
- **LOGOS:** They have hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; and they do not make a sound in their throat.
- **PNEUMA:** They have hands but can't feel. They have feet but can't walk. They can't even make a sound.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but he gave the earth to the human race.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
